name: oligodendrocyte transcription factor 2
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: OLIG2 encodes oligodendrocyte transcription factor 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and protein dimerization activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and myelination.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: OLIG2 can be involved in chromosomal rearrangements associated with T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Expression as a lineage marker is a distinct observation.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-specific alteration context described by NCBI/RefSeq; variant applicability requires review.
